m: अव-√ धा P. (aor. 3. pl. -अधुह्, RV.; Imper. 2. sg. -धेहि and perf. 3. pl. -दधुह्, AV.; ind.p. -धाय; rarely Ā., e.g. perf. -दधे, MBh. i, 4503) to place down, plunge into (loc.), deposit, RV. i, 158, 5 & ix, 13, 4 &c.; to place or turn aside, ŚBr. : Pass. (Imper. -धीयताम्) to be applied or directed (as the mind), Hit. : Caus. (Pot. -धापयेत्) to cause to put into (loc.), ĀśvGṛ.
a: अवधा — {c3c} A. 1 To place down, deposit; अवधाय श्वभ्रे मृत्पिंडं Kāty.; यथा क्षुरः क्षुरधानेऽवहितः Śat. Br.; ततस्तांस्तेषु कुंडेषु गर्भानवदधे तदा Mb.; वासुदेवः स्वमाययात्मन्यवधीयमानः Bhāg.; to fix: पादाग्रे दृशमवधाय निश्चलांगी Mu. 5. 13. --2 To apply (as the mind). --3 To be attentive; इतोऽवधत्तां देवराजः Mv. 6. --4 To shut, close, press together. --Pass. To be placed, applied, or directed (mind); अवधीयतां listen, hear.
अवधानीय — pot. p. To be attended to, deserving attention and care.

s: klI, (ava + DA + lyuw .) manoyogaH । tatparyyAyaH । samADAnaM 2 praRiDAnaM 3 samADiH 4 । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: na॰ ava + DA--lyuw । manoyogaviSeze, yadvaSAt vizayAntarato manonivarttate । “avaDAnapare cakAra sA pralayAntonmizite vilocane” kumA॰ “sAvaDAnAvaDAraya” ta॰
m: अव-धान n. attention, attentiveness, intentness, Kum. iv, 2; Śiś. ix, 11, &c., (cf. सावधन.)
fixing, fastening, MBh.
a: अवधानं — 1 Attention, अवधानपरे चकार सा प्रलयांतोन्मिषिते विलोचने Ku. 4. 2; अवधानं दीयमानं प्रार्थये Ve. 1; intentness, attentiveness; दत्तावधानः शृणोति hears attentively. --2 Devotion, care, carefulness; अवधानात् carefully or attentively; शृणुत जना अवधानात् क्रियामिमां कालिदासस्य V. 1. 2. v. l.

k.v: धीर्धारणावती मेधा सङ्कल्पः कर्म मानसम्. अवधानं समाधानं प्रणिधानमं तथैव च। चित्ताभोगा मनस्कारश्चर्चा संख्या विचारणा। विमर्शो भावना चैव वासना च निगद्यते॥

m: अव-धान—ता, f. [Pañcat.] or अव-धान—त्व, n. [L.] attentiveness.
अव-धान—वत् mfn. attentive, Naiṣ., Sch.
अव-धान—वत्—ता (f.)
अवधानिन् mfn. ‘attentive’, (gaṇa इष्टादि, q.v.)
a: अवधानिन् — a. Attentive.

v: pu॰ ava + Df--Ric--BAve ac । niScaye tadaBAvAprakArakatve sati tatprakArake jYAne “tadaBAvAprakArA DIstatprakArA tu niScaya” iti BAzA॰ । “sarvvatra yadavaDAreRocyate sa ekAntaH” suSru॰ ।
m: अव-धार m. accurate determination limitation, Suśr.
a: अवधारः — Accurate determination, limitation; सर्वत्र यदवधारेणोच्यते स एकांतः Suśr.

v: tri॰ ava + Df--Ric--karmmaRi anIyar । IdfktayA niScetuM yogye । “vizRorivAsyAnavaDAraRIyam” raGuH ।
m: अव-धारणीय mfn. to be ascertained, determined or known, (अन्- neg.), Ragh. xiii, 5
to be considered as ascertained or determined, Hariv. 6252, to be restricted to (instr.)
a: अवधारणीय, अवधर्य — pot. p. To be ascertained, determined or considered; विष्णोरिवास्यानवधारणीयं R. 13. 5; परिणतिरवधार्या यत्नतः पंडितेन Bh. 2. 99.

s: klI, (ava + Df + Ric + lyuw .) niScayaH । yaTA । “hi hetAvavaDAraRe” । ityamaraH ॥
v: na॰ ava + Df--Ric--lyuw । 1 iyattAparicCede, ayamitTameveti vizayaparicCedake 2 niScaye ca । saMKyAdinA 3 iyattAkaraRe “yAvadavaDAraRe” pA॰ । 4 anyatovyAvarttane ca ।
m: अव-धारण अम् n. ascertainment, affirmation, emphasis
stating or holding with positiveness or assurance
accurate determination, limitation (of the sense of words), restriction to a certain instance or instances with exclusion of any other, VPrāt.; Pāṇ. ii, 1, 8; viii, 1, 62, &c.
अव-धारण mfn. restrictive, L.
a: अवधारण — a. Restrictive, limiting. --णं --णा 1 Ascertainment, determination; मान˚ Dk. 161. --2 Affirmation, emphasis. --3 Limitation (of the sense of words); यावदवधारणे, एवावधारणे; मात्रं कार्त्स्न्येऽवधारणे Ak.; तुरत्रावधारणार्थः. --4 Restriction to a certain instance or instances to the exclusion of all others.

m: अव-धारक mfn. determining, bearing upon, meaning
restricting, TPrāt.
a: अवधारक — a. 1 Determining accurately; इष्टावधारकं वाक्यं आशीः Bharata. --2 Restricting oneself to anything.

m: अ-वधार्ह mfn. not worthy of death, L.

s: tri, (ava + Df + Ric + kta .) kftAvaDAraRaH । yaTA । “tvayA sumuKi kiM proktaM na mayA hyavaDAritaM । vivecaya mahABAge saNketo varttate Kalu” ॥ iti vrahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe 20 aDyAyaH ॥
v: tri॰ ava + Df--Ric--kta । yasya saMKyArUpAdinA niScayaHkftaH 1 tasmin anyataH kftavyAvfttiyute 2 padArTe ca ।
m: अव-धारित mfn. ascertained, known, certain, heard, learnt, Mālav. &c.
(ifc. with श्रेण्य्-आदि) ‘known as’, (g. कृतादि, q.v.)
a: अवधारित — p. p. Ascertained, known, well observed, marked; सम्यगवधारितं Ratn. 1.

m: अवधारितिन् mfn. (g. इष्टाद्, q.v.)
अव-धार्य mfn. to be ascertained or known
‘to be made out or understood’, see दुर्-अवध्˚.

s: tri, (ava + Df + Ryat .) avaDAraRIyaH । avapUrvvakaDfDAtorGyaR pratyayena nizpannaH । nirDAryyaH ॥
v: tri॰ ava + Df--Ric--karmmaRiyat । niScetuM Sakye idamitTameveti 1 nirReye ava + Df--Ric--lyap । 2 niScityetyarTe avya॰ ।
na॰ ava + DA--BAve--tavya । 1 avaDAne “tadatra devenAvaDAtavyam” praboDaca॰ । karmmaRitavya । 2 avaDeye tri॰
m: अव-धातव्य n. impers. to be attended to.
a: अवधातव्य — pot. p. To be attended to, deserving attention and care.

m: अव-√ धाव् -धावति to run down, drop down from (abl.), RV. i, 162, 11 and AV. ii, 3, 1.
a: अवधाव् — {c1c} U. To run down, to drop down, to run after.
अवधावनं — 1 Running after, pursuing, seizure. --2 Cleaning, washing.
अवधावित — p. p. 1 Chased, pursued. --2 Cleaned, washed.

m: अव-√ धी (impf. -दीधेत्) to watch or lie in wait for (dat.), RV. x, 144, 3.

a: अवधीर् — {c10c} P. To disregard, disrespect, treat with contempt, slight; अवधीरितसुहृद्वचनस्य H. 1; Śi. 9. 59, Amaru. 83; to despise, repudiate, repulse; तत्किमवधीरयति मामार्यपुत्रः M. 5.

s: t, ka, avajYAyAM । (adanta + curA॰uBaya॰-saka॰-sew .) avaDIrayati । AvaDIrayat sADumasADuH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: avajYAyAm ada॰ curA॰ uBaya॰ saka॰ sew । avaDIrayati te AvavaDIrat ta । avetyasyopasargatve avAdiDIrat ta । avaDIritaH avaDIrI “rasEH kaTA yasya suDAvaDIriRI” nE॰ avetyasyopasargatve “itIva DArAmaraDIryyeti nEzaDa॰ GAtvabayavarUpatve tu avaDIrayitveti BedaH ।

strI avaDIra--BAve yuc । 1 avajYAyAM 2 tiraskAre ca “kftavatyasi nAvaDIraRAmaparAdDe'pi yadA ciraM mayi” raGuH “ayaM sa yasmAt praRayAvaDIraRAmaSaNkanIyAM karaBoru! manTase” Saku॰ । BAve lyuw । tatrArTe na॰ ।
a: अवधीरणा — Disrespect, despising; repulse; कृतवत्यसि नावधीरणामपराद्धे ऽपि यदा चिरं मयि R. 8. 48; M. 3. 19; अयं स ते तिष्ठति संगमोत्सुको विशंकसे भीरु यतोवधीरणां Ś. 3. 14.

m: अव-धीरण, n. or अव-धीरणा, f. treating with disrespect, repudiating, Śak.; Ragh. viii, 47.
a: अवधीरणं — Treating with disrespect.

m: अव-√ धीर्अव-√ धीरय (ind.p. -धीर्य) to disregard, disrespect, repudiate, Śiś. ix, 59; Kathās.; Hit.
अव-धीरिन् mfn. despising, L.
excelling, Daś.
a: अवधीरिन् — a. 1 Despising, scorning. --2 Excelling.

m: अव-धीरित mfn. disrespected, disregarded, Śak. &c.
surpassed, excelled, Sāh.
a: अवधीरित — p. p. Disrespected, disregarded, slighted; अवधीरितार्तवगुणं Ki. 6. 25 excelled, set at naught; अचेतनं नाम गुणं न लक्षयेन्मयैव कस्मादवधीरिता प्रिया Ś. 6. 12.

v: tri॰ ava + DA karmmaRi SAnac । yasmin vizaye cittABiniveSaH kriyate tasmin vizaye ।
m: अव-धीयमान mfn. (Pass. p.) being confined within (acc., ? AV. xii, 5, 30; or loc., R. v, 11, 13).

अव-√ धू Ved. P. (Imper. 2. sg. -धूनुहि, 2. pl. -धूनुता) to shake off or out or down, RV. x, 66, 14 & 134, 3; KātyŚr. &c.: Ā. (2. sg. -धूनुषे; impf. 2. sg. -धूनुथास्; aor. -अधूषत; perf. Pot. -दुधुवीत; p. -धून्वान) to shake off (as enemies or evil spirits or anything disagreeable), frighten away, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. : Caus. (Pot. -धूनयेत्) to shake, Mn. iii, 229.
a: अवधू — {c5c} U. 1 To shake. move, wave, cause to tremble; रेणुः पवनावधूतः R. 7. 43; लीलावधूतैः चामरैः Me. 35; Rs. 6. 15; Ki. 6. 3; Śi. 13. 36. --2 To shake off or out, shake, toss (lit. and fig.), remove (fig. also); overcome, get the better of; राजसत्त्वमवधूय मातृकं R. 11. 90; सुरवधूरवधूतभयाः शरैः 9. 19 removing the fears of; अवधूय तद्व्यथां 3. 61; व्रजंति शत्रूनवधूय निस्पृहाः शमेन सिद्धिं मुनयो न भूभृतः Ki. 1. 42; रुषावधूय रक्षांसि Rām. --3 To discard, spurn, reject or treat with contempt, disregard; चंडी मामवधूय पादपतितं V. 4. 38; Ku. 3. 8; अवधूतप्रणिपाताः V. 3. 5; अवधूतदुहितृप्रार्थनस्य Dk. 13. --Caus. (-धूनयति) To shake.

m: अ-वधू-क mfn. having no wife,L.
a: अवधूकः — One having no wife.

v: na॰ DaliM karoti ava + DUli--kftyarTe Ric--BAve lyuw । avacUrRane ।
m: अव-धूलन n. (cf. धूलि) scattering over, strewing, Bhpr.
a: अवधूलनं — Sprinkling absorbent powders on sores.

m: अव-धूलित mfn. scattered over, covered, Śārṅg.

v: na॰ ava + DU--Ric--nuk lyuw । 1 cAlane । (JAqA) iti KyAte vyApAre “pAdasparSastu rakzAMsi durzkftInavaDUnanam” manuH । 2 cikitsABede ca “tatra tUrRRaM galApIqaM kuryyAccApyavaDUnanam” suSru॰ ।
m: अव-धूनन n. shaking, causing to shake, MBh. viii, 4380; Mn. iii, 230, &c.
agitation, shaking (of the earth), Car.
a: अवधूननं — 1 Shaking, waving; पादस्पर्शस्तु रक्षांसि दुष्कृतीनवधूननं Ms. 3. 230; अमंददष्टौष्ठकरावधूननम् Ki. 8. 6. --2 The practice of medicine, curing. --3 Agitation, trembling. --4 Disregarding. --5 Trampling on, treading.

m: अव-धूपित mfn. perfumed with incense, R. ii, 83, 16 (v.l.)
a: अवधूपित — a. Perfumed with incense.

s: puM, (ava + DU + ktaH .) sannyAsASramI । tadviDAnaM sannyAsiSabde drazwavyaM । tadBedA yaTA । devyuvAca । “dviviDAvASramO proktO gArhasTyo BEkzukastaTA । kimidaM SrUyate citramavaDUtAScaturviDAH ॥ etadveditumicCAmi tattvataH kaTaya praBo । caturvviDAvaDUtAnAM lakzaRAni viSezataH ॥ sadASiva uvAca । brahmamantropAsakA ye brAhmaRakzatriyAdayaH । gfhASrame vasanto'pi jYeyAste yatayaH priye ॥ pUrRABizekaviDinA saMskftA ye ca mAnavAH । SEvAvaDUtAste jYeyAH pUjanIyAH kulArccite ॥ brahmAvaDUtaH SEvASca sAgrimAcAravarttinaH । vidaDyuH sarvvakarmmARi SaSvadIritavartmanA ॥ vinA brahmArpitaYcEte taTA cakrArpitaM vinA । nizidDamannaM toyaYca na gfhlIyuH kadAcana ॥ brahmAvaDUtakOlAnAM kOlAnAmaBizekiRAM । prAgeva kaTito Darmma AcAraSca varAnane ॥ snAnaM saMnyAsanaM pAnaM dAnaYca dArarakzaRaM । sarvvamAgamamArgeRa SEvabrahmAvaDUtayoH” ॥ iti mahAnirvvARatantre 14 ullAsaH ॥ * ॥ anyacca । SaNkara uvAca । “SfRu devi pravakzyAmi avaDUto yaTA Bavet । vIrasya mUrttiM jAnIyAt sadA tattvaparAyaRaH ॥ yadrUpaM kaTitaM sarvvaM sannyAsaDAraRaM paraM । tadrUpaM sarvvakarmmARi prakuryyAdvIravallaBaM ॥ daRqino muRqanaM cAmAvAsyAyAmAcaredyaTA । taTA nEva prakuryyAttu vIrasya muRqanaM priye ॥ asaMskftaM keSajAlamuktAlambikacoccayaM । asTimAlA viBUzA vA rudrAkzAnapi DArayet ॥ digambaro vA vIrendraScATa vA kOpinI Bavet । raktacandanasiktANgaM kuryyAdBasmANgaBUzaRaM” ॥ rati nirvvARatantre 14 pawalaH ॥ * ॥ apica । “nfkarowiM viDAryyaYca kAzWadaRqaM taTA priye । paraSuYcAjinaYcEva yogIva DArayet sadA ॥ KawwANgaM DArayedyogI vAsarUpakavAsasI । kapAle DArayeccandraM candanAdyErvviSezataH ॥ Izat piNgalakaM vastraM DArayet sarvvadA suta” । suta iti Sivasya samboDanaM । sudarSanAKyaM yaccakraM tattu saMDArayedbuDaH ॥ vipaYcIM kapilaYcEva maqqaqiRqimaJarJarAn । vAdayan qamaruM yogI yatra kutrASrame sTitaH” ॥ iti yogasAre 2 paricCedaH ॥ * ॥ aparaYca । “kzamA dAnaM tapo DyAnaM bAlaBAvena SElaje । Sivo'haM BEravAnando mukto'haM kulanAyakaH ॥ evaM BAvaparo mantrI hetuyuktaH sadASivaH । saMvidAsevanaM kuryyAt sadA kAraRasevanaM ॥ Bavet sAkzAt sa puruzaH SamBurUpo na saMSayaH” । iti nirvvARatantraM ॥ * ॥ kiYca । “brAhmaRaH kzatriyo vESyaH SUdraH sAmAnya eva ca । kulAvaDUtasaMskAre paYcAnAmaDikAritA” ॥ iti mahAnirvvARatantraM ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “nirvvARamuktimApnoti brAhmaRo vIraBAvataH । avaDUtaH kzatriyaSca mahAyogI na saMSayaH ॥ svarUpo'pi BavedvESyaH SUdro'pi sahalokavAn । sampUrRaPalamApnoti vipro nirvvARatAM vrajet ॥ triBAgaM PalamApnoti kzatriyo vIraBAvataH । pAdadvayantu vESyasya SUdrasya cEkapAdakaM” ॥ * ॥ daSanAmAvaDUtAnAM pratyekaM nAma prAguktamidAnImapi tezAM praDAnatvenANgIkaraRArTaM saMjYAkaTanagarBaM lakzaRaviSezamAha । “avaDUtasya cAKyAnaM SfRuzva parbbatAtmaje । vanAraRye BAratI ca giriSca purireva ca ॥ ekasTAne tu saMsTitya izwaDyAnAdikaYcaret । yo mantradAnaM tapasA savanaH parikIrttitaH ॥ snastakeSo jawAjUwaH sadA vAtulavadBavet । antaryogI mahAvIro'raRyasaMjYaSca SElaje ॥ nAnASAstrezu yo vijYo nAnAkarmmaviSAradaH । sadezwadevIBAvena BAvayed yo hi cAbalAM ॥ sa eva BAratIvIro mahAjYAnI jitendriyaH । sadordDvabAhuryo vIro muktakeSo digambaraH ॥ sarvvatra samaBAvena BAvayet yo narottamaH ॥ izwadevIM vinA nAsti sa giriH parikIrttitaH ॥ nAnAdeSezu pIWezu kzetrezu tIrTaBUmizu । BramaRaM kurute nityaM kuryyAdyatnena pUjanaM ॥ devatAyAH sadA DyAnaM SrIguroH pUjanaM taTA । antaryAgezu yo nizWaH sa vIraH purireva ca ॥ avaDUtASrame devi ! yasya BaktiH suniScalA । tasya tuzwA Bavet kAlI kiM na sidDyati BUtale ॥ avaDUtaM samAlokya SamBuvat pUjanaM caret । SaktitaH paYcatattvAni yatnenEva nivedayet । aSaktaH parameSAni BaktitaH paritozayet” ॥ iti nirvvARatantraM ॥ * ॥ api ca । “BaktAvaDUto dviviDaH pUrRApUrRaviBedataH । pUrRaH paramahaMsAKyaH parivrAqaparaH smftaH ॥ kftAvaDUtasaMskAro yadi syAjjYAnadurbbalaH । tadA lokAlaye tizWannAtmAnaM sa tu SoDayet ॥ rakzan svajAticihnaYca kurvvan karmmARi kevalaM । sadA brahmaparo BUtvA sADayejjYAnamuttamaM” ॥ iti mahAnirvvARatantraM ॥ * ॥ api ca । “avaDUtaH SivaH sAkzAdavaDUtaH sadASivaH । avaDUtI SivAdevI avaDUtASramaM SfRu ॥ caturASramiRAM maDye avaDUtASramo mahAn । avaDUtaSca dviviDo gfhasTaSca citAnugaH ॥ sacelaScApi digvAsA viDiyonivihAravAn । sadAraH sarvvadArasTaScAwwahAso digambaraH ॥ gfhAvaDUto deveSi dvitayastu sadASivaH” । iti muRqamAlAtantre 2 pawalaH ॥ * ॥ avaDUtasya om tat saditi mantreRa karmmakarttavyatAmAha । “o~ tatsanmantramuccAryya so'hamasmIti cintayan । kuryyAdAtmocitaM karmma sadA vErAgyamASritaH ॥ kurvvan karmmARyanAsakto nalinodalanIravat । yatetAtmAnamudDarttuM tattvajYAnavivekataH” ॥ * ॥ sarvvezAmom tatsaditi nirdeSena karmmaPalamAha । “o~ tatsaditi mantreRa yo yatkarmma samAcaret । gfhasTo vApyudAsInastasyABIzwAya tadBavet” ॥ * ॥ tanmantrakriyamARakarmmaRaH sampUrRatvamapi । “japahomapratizWA ca saMskArAdyaKilAH kriyAH । o~ tatsaditi nizpannAH saMpUrRAH syurna saMSayaH ॥ kimanyErbbahuBirmmantrEH kimanyErBUrisADanEH । brAhmyeRAnena mantreRa sarvvakarmmARi sADayet ॥ suKasADyamabAhulyaM saMpUrRaPaladAyakaM । nAstyetasmAnmahAmantrAdupAyAntaramambike ॥ purapradeSe dehe vA liKitvA DArayedimaM । gehe tasya mahAtIrTaM dehaH puRyamayo Bavet ॥ nigamAgamatantrARAM sArAt sArataro manuH । o~ tatsaditi deveSi
